hard_nevers: Never push or open a PR unless asked, even with green CI.
Never publish a GitHub release, run release.yml or push to nuget.org without approval.
Never move the packages off EF Core 10.x / net10.0 or raise dependency floors without approval; consumers inherit them.
Never relax a migrations-remove refusal (newer file on disk, missing from revision, applied without --force, no git) to make a case pass.
failure_modes: Claiming behavior (publish output, EF service ordering) without running dotnet ef / dotnet publish to prove it.
Tests reimplementing production logic or mocking what an end-to-end test should exercise.
Design-dependent types leaking into the runtime package or consumers, so Assembly.GetTypes() throws in production.
Rewriting EF-generated code without keeping BOM/line endings and using order, or without failing loudly when the scaffolded shape changes.
answers.failure_modes_note: Engineer selected all options but answered 'no idea': these come from pitfalls found during extraction from an internal project, not from observed agent failures.
done_definition: dotnet build DesignerlessMigrations.slnx passes with zero warnings (TreatWarningsAsErrors).
dotnet test --solution DesignerlessMigrations.slnx passes, including the EndToEnd tests (Docker + git).
bash eng/test-samples.sh passes against freshly packed packages.
README.md reflects any behavior or setup change.
